The strongest pro-equality evidence is programmatic and institutional; the strongest negative evidence is outcome-based and rights-based.","evidence":[{"title":"In Detail: The Student Loan (Access to Higher Education) Act, 2024","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/in-detail-the-student-loan-access-to-higher-education-act-2024/","summary":"Tinubu signed a student-loan law that broadened access to higher education and skills training, removed income and guarantor barriers, and added a fairness clause on national spread. This is strong positive evidence for equal opportunity, not just aggregate welfare.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Establishes National Education Data System and Approves Skill Development for all Levels of Education, Teacher’s Training and Support Nationwide","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"2024-04-18","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-national-education-data-system-and-approves-skill-development-for-all-levels-of-education-teachers-training-and-support-nationwide/","summary":"The education package emphasized out-of-school children, teacher training, and a data repository for planning. That supports a genuine equality-and-capabilities agenda, though it is still more policy design than outcome proof.","question_ids":["6B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Launches Education Campaign, Sys no Child Should be Excluded from Learning","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-education-campaign-sys-no-child-should-be-excluded-from-learning/","summary":"Tinubu publicly linked women’s rights, girls’ education, safe schooling, and anti-GBV policy to national development and access to opportunity. This is positive evidence for dignity and equal opportunity, especially for women and girls.","question_ids":["6B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Launches National Resettlement Scheme For Conflict Victims","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"2024-07-06","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-national-resettlement-scheme-for-conflict-victims/","summary":"The resettlement scheme targeted displaced and conflict-affected communities and promised housing, roads, schools, and reintegration. This is one of the clearest direct 2024 examples of restoring dignity to a vulnerable group.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"My Resolve To Enhance Nigeria’s Security Unwavering – President Tinubu","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/my-resolve-to-enhance-nigerias-security-unwavering-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu framed state policing as a way to improve accountability, safeguard civil liberties, and fit policing to community needs. That is positive institutional evidence for equal treatment and dignity, though it remains rhetorical.","question_ids":["6B.8","4B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria: 10 Years After Chibok, Schoolchildren Still at Risk","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-04-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/11/nigeria-10-years-after-chibok-schoolchildren-still-risk","summary":"HRW said Nigerian authorities had failed to sustain safe-learning measures and children in northern Nigeria remained at serious risk of abduction. This is strong negative evidence against equal opportunity in practice, especially for education access and child protection.","question_ids":["6B.8"]},{"title":"Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency","publisher":"BusinessDay","date":"2024-02-21","url":"https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/","summary":"Tinubu’s appointment of his son-in-law to lead the Federal Housing Authority drew explicit nepotism criticism. This is the clearest housing-related patronage signal and weakens the equal-opportunity claim.","question_ids":["6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"Committee to Protect Journalists","date":"2024-10-03","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/","summary":"Journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act after corruption reporting, showing continued legal pressure on scrutiny and criticism. That is negative evidence for dignity, equal standing, and equal access to public accountability.","question_ids":["6B.8","4B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Protesters Charged with Treason","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-09-06","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason","summary":"HRW reported treason charges, prolonged detention, and due-process concerns for protesters, including children. This is strong negative evidence that the state did not treat dissenting citizens as equals in practice.","question_ids":["6B.8","2B.5","3B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #Endbadgovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-28","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty documented at least 24 deaths, over 1,200 detentions, and abusive protest policing. That is the clearest evidence against a dignity-protective record in 2024.","question_ids":["6B.8","2B.5","3B.4"]}]}
